scanSummary.note: Public repositories are selectively grouped into portfolio entries. Forks, small experiments, and overlapping utilities are omitted. Private repository names are intentionally not listed.

projects.title: Mahak Backend Platform
projects.summary: Service platform for Dabestaniha apps: auth, shop, LMS, campaigns, game maps, payments, notifications, API documentation, and admin workflows.

projects.title: DomainOps
projects.summary: Local-first Go TUI and JSON CLI for multi-account Cloudflare DNS, TLS, and ACME certificate operations, with an encrypted vault, SQLite cache, conflict-safe mutations, audit history, and headless automation.

projects.title: Easy Stream
projects.summary: Browser-first media archive stack that scans read-only MKV libraries and produces signed CMAF/fMP4 HLS on demand, with bounded caching, worker queues, FFmpeg validation, Docker deployment, and an RTL/TV interface.

projects.title: Nyone
projects.summary: Live-streaming platform built with Laravel, Inertia, React, and MediaMTX, supporting creator channels, OBS/RTMP publishing, HLS playback, follows, live chat, creator-selected VOD recording, and admin moderation.

projects.title: Smart Warehouse Allocation
projects.summary: Low-latency FastAPI and Redis microservice that deterministically selects and atomically reserves the best warehouse across inventory, cost, ETA, traffic, fleet, and SLA constraints, with metrics and load benchmarks.

projects.title: BankFlow
projects.summary: Laravel service for versioned loan-application workflows, running validation, fraud, guarantor, credit, and approval stages with immutable rule snapshots, auditable results, a Filament admin panel, PostgreSQL, and Pest tests.

projects.title: Nginx Monitoring Stack
projects.summary: Dependency-free C module exposing Linux and Nginx telemetry through dashboard, JSON, SSE, health, and Prometheus endpoints, paired with a Kotlin fleet-monitoring app with encrypted credentials, alerts, history, and widgets.

projects.title: Post HUB
projects.summary: Mobile-first Postman-style Android client for composing requests, saving history and environments, chaining flows with captured values, inspecting responses, and running a saved flow from a home-screen widget.

projects.title: Nova Form Card
projects.summary: Laravel Nova 5 package that turns cards into submit-capable forms using standard Nova fields, with validation, dependencies, uploads, authorization, and structured success, redirect, refresh, or error responses.

projects.title: Embedd HUB
projects.summary: Local-first Laravel workbench for generating, storing, searching, and comparing text embeddings with Ollama and PostgreSQL/pgvector, including model discovery, availability checks, similarity matrices, and usage tracking.

projects.title: Mahak Kids App Ecosystem
projects.summary: Android and multiplatform app work for kids, including Kotlin clients, shared libraries, educational games, and Compose/KMP experiments.

projects.title: Learning & Content Apps
projects.summary: A suite of education and content apps covering language learning, LMS flows, religious content, stories, media guides, and user progress.

projects.title: Modular Android Architecture
projects.summary: Reusable feature modules and themed UI/data packages for LMS, inbox, gallery, dictionary, messaging, campaigns, competitions, content, and notifications.

projects.title: Quranic Train & Games
projects.summary: Educational game work around Quranic learning, including C# mini-games, Kotlin clients, game-map components, and supporting backend services.

projects.title: Build & DevOps Automation
projects.summary: Automation for application builds and releases, changed-file Laravel FTP deployments, local HTTPS PHP project routing, Gradle plugins, Docker services, documentation sync, and Git helpers.

projects.title: Public Web & Compliance Pages
projects.summary: Public-facing privacy policies, account deletion pages, landing pages, and static service pages for multiple Dabestaniha products.

projects.title: Fluent Chat
projects.summary: A modern Laravel chat platform with Livewire, Flux UI, group and direct conversations, file messages, settings, and feature tests.

projects.title: ISP & Telecom Clients
projects.summary: Cross-platform Kotlin and Rust clients for MCI, TCI, and Jahan Nama service status, with session renewal, encrypted local credentials, background refresh, widgets, desktop trays and overlays, diagnostics, and packaged releases.

projects.title: Text Rendering Engine
projects.summary: A Python and Pillow CLI for Photoshop-like text rendering with gradients, stroke, shadow, glow, rotation, validation, and RTL support.

projects.title: Server Operations Toolkit
projects.summary: Practical operations tools for Git backups, Git remotes, MinIO workflows, cPanel DNS notes, Nginx autoindex, PHP webhooks, and safe server shutdown.

projects.title: Messenger Bots & Clients
projects.summary: Automation experiments for Eitaa and Bale, plus a Whisper-based voice-to-text bot for message and media workflows.

projects.title: Persian Utility Tools
projects.summary: Utilities for Persian and RTL workflows, ChatGPT Markdown/PDF export, QR-code generation, directory listing, and Python data-layer experiments inspired by Laravel patterns.
